seo.title: Salt Exporter from India: Global Supply | Ankur Chemfood Ltd.
seo.description: Ankur Chemfood Ltd. exports triple refined, certified salt from India to international buyers. Global markets, export certifications, port access and bulk export enquiries.

hero.title: Salt Exporter from India Global Supply
hero.intro: Triple refined, Swiss technology salt manufactured on India's marine salt belt in Gujarat, supplied to international buyers with the certifications and port access that global trade demands.

globalMarkets.heading: Global Markets We Serve
globalMarkets.subheading: Our export network, grouped by region and updated as new markets come online.

certifications.heading: Export Certifications
certifications.subheading: The compliance documentation international buyers ask for first: not a logo wall, the real standards behind it.

items.name: FSSAI
items.issuer: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
items.description: Our FSSAI license means we are registered, inspected and authorised to manufacture and export food grade salt from India.

items.name: Halal Certified
items.description: Confirms our manufacturing process meets Islamic dietary requirements, verified by an accredited certifying body. It's a requirement for many of our Middle East and Africa buyers.

items.name: FSSC 22000
items.description: One of the most widely recognised food safety certifications globally, accepted by retailers and food businesses across every market we ship to.

items.name: ISO 9001:2015
items.description: Confirms our processes, from sourcing to packaging, are consistently managed and audited to an international quality standard, not checked just once.

logistics.heading: Port & Logistics Advantage
logistics.subheading: Built on India's busiest export corridor: not a courier route, direct access from plant to port.

ports.name: Kandla Port
ports.description: One of India's largest cargo ports by volume, sitting minutes from our manufacturing plants on National Highway 8A. Built for high volume bulk export.

ports.name: Mundra Port
ports.description: India's largest private port and container terminal, giving us direct access to major global shipping lines for containerised export.

inquiry.heading: Export Inquiry
inquiry.intro: Tell us your requirement, and our export team will follow up with a quote and lead time.
benefits: Triple refined salt manufactured on Gujarat's marine salt belt
